## Practice Areas
- [Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/income-tax-itr): Salaried, business, and capital gains tax filing.
- [GST Registration](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/gst-registration): New GST registration and composition scheme.
- [GST Return Filing (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B)](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/gst-returns): Monthly and annual compliance.
- [Private Limited Company Incorporation](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/private-limited-company): MCA SPICe+ company setup.
- [Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Registration](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/llp-registration): LLP incorporation and drafting.
- [Partnership Firm Registration](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/firm-registration): Firm registration and deed drafting.
- [Udyam MSME Registration](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/udyam-registration): Government of India MSME certification.
- [Mumbai Gumasta (Shop & Establishment) License](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/gumasta-shop-establishment): MCGM commercial license.
- [Accounting & Bookkeeping Services](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/accounting-services): Financial finalization and ledger review.
- [ROC Annual Compliance & Filings](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/roc-compliance): MCA AOC-4, MGT-7, and KYC filings.
- [TDS / TCS Filings & Returns](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/tds-tcs-services): Quarterly 24Q, 26Q compliance.
- [Provident Fund (PF) Services](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/pf-services): EPFO filings and member management.
- [FSSAI Food License Registration](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/fssai-registration): FBO licensing and registration.
- [Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate (DSC)](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/digital-signature-certificate): MCA, ITR, and e-tender token.
- [Trademark Registration Assistance](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/trademark-registration): Brand and logo registration.
- [Import Export Code (IEC)](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/import-export-code): DGFT international trade license.
- [Auditing & Assurance Services](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/auditing-assurance): Independent assurance and audits.
- [NRI Taxation Services](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/nri-taxation): Non-resident Indian tax advisory and DTAA.
- [Transfer Pricing Advisory](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/transfer-pricing): Domestic and international transfer pricing.
- [Registration of Indian Subsidiary Company](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/indian-subsidiary-registration): Foreign subsidiary setup.
- [Foreign Company Branch & Liaison Office](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/foreign-company-registration): Branch setup in India.
- [Tax Investment & Financial Advisory](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#/service/financial-advisory): Comprehensive tax advisory.
